overviewParagraphs: Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An occupies a uniquely beautiful stretch of land near the UNESCO World Heritage town of Hoi An. The 18-hole layout flows through rolling coastal dunes, shaded by magnificent old-growth casuarina and melaleuca trees that give it a timeless, park-like character.

Wide, generous fairways make the course accessible to golfers of all abilities, yet the strategic placement of bunkering and water hazards ensure that scoring well requires discipline. Hole 9 — a sweeping par-5 across a natural dune valley — is among the most photographically stunning in Vietnam.

The course is part of Vinpearl's premium resort complex, which includes five-star accommodation, multiple dining outlets, a casino, and a world-class spa. It is an ideal base for golfers looking to explore both the Hoi An golf corridor and the nearby Da Nang club circuit.

curatorBriefHtml: Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An sits just 20 minutes south of Hoi An Ancient Town and 10 minutes down the coast from Hoiana Shores — making it the easiest, most forgiving championship layout on Vietnam’s Central Coast. Designed by IMG Worldwide (Par 72, 7,035 yards), the course pairs wide, inviting SeaIsle Paspalum fairways with gleaming white sand waste bunkers, gentle coastal dunes, and smooth, generous greens.

Having played Vinpearl Nam Hoi An personally, I frequently recommend it as the Day 1 warm-up round on a 4-round Da Nang / Hoi An tour. After a long flight from Australia, Europe, or the US, its spacious landing zones let your group shake off travel rust and build confidence before tackling the tighter dunes of Hoiana Shores and the dramatic mountain elevation of Ba Na Hills.
Vinpearl Nam Hoi An features on our Hoi An Beachfront Bliss signature tour, with short 15–20 minute transfers from An Bang Beach villas and Palm Garden Beach Resort.

scorecard.verdict: A beautifully manicured resort course featuring expansive white sand bunkers and wide fairways that wind through coastal woodlands. Highly enjoyable for mixed-handicap group societies.

faqs.q: How does Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An fit into a Da Nang & Hoi An golf itinerary?
faqs.a: Located just 20 minutes south of Hoi An and 10 minutes from Hoiana Shores, Vinpearl Nam Hoi An is the ideal first-day warm-up round on a 4- or 5-round Central Coast trip — wide fairways and fair resort greens make it enjoyable for all handicap levels.

faqs.q: What are the signature features of Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An?
faqs.a: IMG Worldwide styled the layout around sweeping white-sand waste bunkers, lush casuarina trees, wide Paspalum corridors, and bold, gently contoured greens — including the dramatic par-4 1st and water-guarded finishing stretch.

faqs.q: How far is Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An from Hoi An and Da Nang?
faqs.a: Transfer time is approximately 20–25 minutes from Hoi An / An Bang Beach and 45–50 minutes south of Da Nang International Airport (DAD) by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An?
faqs.a: February through September offers warm, sunny Central Coast weather and firm fairways. Morning tee times (07:30–09:00 AM) avoid midday heat during May–August.
